concept.title: Chapter 3: Storage and Management
concept.shortdesc: Processed data is stored in a centralized repository, which may include data lakes, warehouses, or cloud-based storage solutions.

conbody.p: The storage architecture is optimized for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. Metadata management tools catalog datasets, track lineage, and facilitate search and discovery. Access policies and role-based permissions protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with organizational standards. Backup and disaster recovery strategies are implemented to safeguard against data loss. Ongoing monitoring and maintenance routines help maintain system health and adapt to evolving storage needs.
